s = input()

ans = ""
flag = False
i = 0
length = len(s)

while i < length:
    # Check for "dot"
    if i + 2 < length and i != 0:
        temp = s[i:i+3]
        if temp == "dot":
            ans += '.'
            i += 3
            continue
        # Check for "at"
        temp = s[i:i+2]
        if temp == "at" and not flag:
            ans += '@'
            i += 2
            flag = True
            continue
    # Check for "at" when not at start and flag not set
    if i + 1 < length and not flag and i != 0:
        temp = s[i:i+2]
        if temp == "at" and not flag:
            ans += '@'
            i += 2
            flag = True
            continue
    # Default case: append current character
    ans += s[i]
    i += 1

print(ans)
